0022600206.text: The Memphis Grizzlies (6-2, 4-0 on the road) visit the Toronto Raptors (4-4) as they try to end a two-game skid, sitting 3rd in the Southwest and 5th in the West, while Toronto is 4th in the Atlantic and 5th in the East after losing its most recent game. Memphis is without Isaiah Stewart (knee bruise) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), and Toronto is missing Immanuel Quickley (hamstring), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), Nate Bittle (foot fracture) and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and Memphis lost both meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently 128-96 in Memphis on April 3, 2026.
